definition_zh: 在那里；往那里；在那里存在或发生（there be 句型）；用于引起注意或安慰
definition_en: in, at, or to that place, or used with be to say that something exists or happens
core_image: 手指向远处的一点：不是这里，是那一边
scene: 山顶的灯塔亮了，他抬手指向海湾对面。The lighthouse on the hill points to a small island over there.
sceneCN: 这里 there 是「在那里、往那边」（第 1 个义项：指远处的地方）；句意：山上的灯塔指向那边的一座小岛。

pos.zh: 在那里；往那里；在那一刻
（与 be 连用）表示存在；有

collocations.zh: 在外面；在广阔的世界上

derivatives.zh: 此后；以后（there 加 after 构成，指在那之后的时间）
在其中；在那一点上（there 加 in 构成的正式用语）
因此；所以（there 加 for 构成，表示由那推出的结果）
由此；从而（there 加 by 构成，表示借那件事）

senses.title: In or to that place
senses.definition: in, at, or to the place that has been mentioned or is being pointed at
senses.definitionCN: 在或到已被提到或正被指出的那个地方
senses.example: We drove to the beach and stayed there all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 我们开车去海边，在那里待了一下午。
senses.why: The word simply replaces the name of a distant place: instead of repeating where, you point with there.
senses.whyCN: 这个词只是代替远处地点的名字：不必重复地名，用 there 一指即可。

senses.title: Existence with be
senses.definition: used with be to say that something exists, happens, or is present
senses.definitionCN: 与 be 连用，表示某物存在、发生或在场
senses.example: There are two letters waiting for you on the desk.
senses.exampleCN: 桌上有两封等你拆的信。
senses.why: English puts the empty pointer there before the verb so that the new thing can arrive last, where it gets the stress.
senses.whyCN: 英语让空指的 there 站在动词前，好让新信息落在句末重音的位置上。

senses.title: At that point or moment
senses.definition: at that point in a process, argument, or situation
senses.definitionCN: 在某个进程、争论或局面的那一点上
senses.example: The talks stopped there and never moved forward again.
senses.exampleCN: 谈判停在那里，再没有向前推进。
senses.why: A process can be imagined as a road; there marks the spot on the road where things stand or stop.
senses.whyCN: 进程可以被想象成一条路；there 标出路上事情所处的或停下的那个点。

senses.title: Attention, comfort or greeting
senses.definition: used to attract attention, to comfort someone, or as an exclamation of triumph or sympathy
senses.definitionCN: 用于引起注意、安慰别人，或表示得意、同情的感叹
senses.example: There, there, the pain will be gone by morning.
senses.exampleCN: 好了，好了，到早上疼痛就会过去的。
senses.why: The pointing word turns toward a person: it calls attention, or pats the shoulder like a hand.
senses.whyCN: 指示词转向了人：它唤起注意，或像一只手一样拍拍肩膀。

intro.en: There is one of the oldest words in English, a native pointing adverb built on the same ancient demonstrative stem as the and that.
intro.cn: there 是英语最古老的词之一，是本土的指示副词，与 the、that 同出于一个古老的指示词干。

items.en: The reconstructed Germanic form is Thar, built on the demonstrative stem tha- that also gave the, that, they and this family of words.
items.cn: 重构的日耳曼语形式一般认为写作 Thar，建立在指示词干 tha- 之上；the、that、they 等词都出自这个词干。

items.en: Old English Ther meant in that place. It already served both as a place adverb and, with be, as an existence marker in some constructions.
items.cn: 古英语 Ther 意为「在那个地方」。它既作地点副词，也在一些句式里与 be 连用表示存在。

items.en: Scandinavian settlers used a closely related form, and in northern texts the Norse shape reinforced the English one.
items.cn: 斯堪的纳维亚移民使用一个十分相近的形式，在北部文献中，古诺斯语的形状加强了英语本词。

items.en: Middle English there spread the there be existence pattern widely, and a whole family of there compounds such as therein and thereby grew up.
items.cn: 中古英语 there 使 there be 存在句式广泛流行，therein、thereby 等一大批 there 复合词也在这一时期形成。

items.en: Modern English fixed the spelling there, and the empty-subject use in There is a book became one of the most common patterns in the language.
items.cn: 现代英语固定了拼写 there，而 There is a book 这类空主语句式成为英语中最常见的句型之一。

note.en: The first group collects the there- compounds that hide inside longer words; the second compares English words of pointing and place.
note.cn: 第一组是藏在长词内部的 there- 复合词家族；第二组比较英语中表示指示与地点的词。

entries.definition: possessive of they; sounds the same as there but owns things instead of locating them
entries.definitionCN: 他们的（they 的所有格）；与 there 同音，但表示所属而非地点

entries.definition: contraction of they are; a third same-sounding form often confused with there in writing
entries.definitionCN: they are 的缩写；第三个同音形式，书写中常与 there 混淆

entries.definition: by that means or as a result; there plus the preposition by
entries.definitionCN: 由此；从而（there 加介词 by 构成的复合词）

entries.definition: in or to this place, near the speaker; the near pole of the same pointing pair
entries.definitionCN: 在这里；往这里（靠近说话者一方），与 there 构成远近对立

entries.definition: over there, at a distance within sight; an old-fashioned pointing word
entries.definitionCN: 那边（目力所及的远处）；旧式的指示词

entries.definition: to that place; the old motion form of there, now literary
entries.definitionCN: 往那里；there 的古体运动方向形式，今仅见于书面

normalIntro.en: Real hooks: the same old stem as the and that, the there be pattern, and the there- compound family.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：与 the、that 同源的古词干、there be 存在句型、以及 there- 复合词家族。

normal.en: There here: here is near, there is far, one vowel apart.
normal.cn: here 与 there：here 近，there 远，一个元音之差。

normal.en: There is and there are put the real subject at the end of the sentence.
normal.cn: there is 和 there are 把真正的主语放在句末。

normal.en: Their, there, they're all sound the same: owning, pointing, contracting.
normal.cn: their、there、they're 同音：一个表所属，一个指示，一个是缩写。

normal.en: Therein, thereby, therefore all carry there inside a longer word.
normal.cn: therein、thereby、therefore 都把 there 藏在更长的词里。

normal.en: There, there is what you say while patting someone's shoulder.
normal.cn: there, there 是你拍着别人肩膀时说的话。

abstract.en: There is a finger stretched toward the far side of the map.
abstract.cn: there 是一根伸向地图远端的手指。

abstract.en: Every sentence needs an empty chair before the new guest walks in; there is that chair.
abstract.cn: 每句话都需要一把空椅子，好让新客人落座；there 就是那把椅子。

abstract.en: Here is where you stand; there is everything you can point to.
abstract.cn: here 是你站立之处；there 是你指向的一切。

examples.en: Put the keys there, on the shelf by the door.
examples.cn: 把钥匙放在那儿，门边的架子上。

examples.en: There is a small cafe at the end of this street.
examples.cn: 这条街的尽头有一家小咖啡馆。

examples.en: There, the work is finally done.
examples.cn: 好了，活儿终于干完了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「在这儿」倒过来——不在这儿，在「那儿」 → there 在那里

root: 英语本土指示副词：出自日耳曼语指示词干 tha-（与 the、that、they 同源），古英语 Ther「在那个地方」，与 here「这里」构成远近对立。无拉丁语来源。

sensesIntro.en: There starts as a plain pointing word, then stretches into the existence marker of there be, a point in a process, and finally a spoken pat on the shoulder.
sensesIntro.cn: there 从单纯的指示词出发，延伸为 there be 的存在标记、进程中的某一点，最后变成口语里安慰人的一声轻拍。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger pointing away from the speaker, to a far spot on the map.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根手指离开说话者，指向远处地图上的一个点。

branches.en: The basic place pointing that replaces a repeated name of a place.
branches.cn: 基本的地点指示，代替重复出现的地名。

branches.en: The empty pointer that lets a new thing enter at the end of the sentence.
branches.cn: 空指的引导词，让新信息进入句末。

branches.en: The road image: a spot where a process stands still or moves on.
branches.cn: 道路意象：进程停留或前进的某个点。

branches.en: The word turns to a person, calling or comforting.
branches.cn: 词转向人，或唤起注意，或安慰对方。

branches.en: Both senses share one gesture: setting something at a spot, real or grammatical.
branches.cn: 两个义项共享同一个手势：把某物安放在某个位置上，无论实指还是语法上的。

intro.en: There has no suffix of its own, but it serves as the first half of a large family of formal compounds, there plus a small function word.
intro.cn: there 本身没有后缀，但它是庞大的正式复合词家族的前半部分：there 加一个小功能词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source; the family is native Germanic, so the Latin entry list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: there 没有拉丁语来源，词族属日耳曼本土，因此拉丁词条列表留空。

items.example: The details are listed therein.
He was accused and convicted thereof.
The annex and everything thereto was signed.
items.exampleCN: 附件及其相关部分均已签署。

items.example: Prices fell, thereby helping exporters.
items.exampleCN: 价格下降，从而帮助了出口商。

items.example: She left the company and thereafter worked freelance.
items.exampleCN: 她离开公司，此后做自由职业。

items.example: It rained; therefore the match was cancelled.
items.exampleCN: 下雨了，因此比赛取消了。

items.meaningCN: 在那附近；大约那个数目
items.example: The village lies thereabouts.

items.meaningCN: 在该条款之下（法律用语）
items.example: Rights granted thereunder must be exercised in writing.
items.exampleCN: 依该条款授予的权利须以书面形式行使。

items.meaning: used to say that something exists
items.example: There were many questions left unanswered.
items.exampleCN: 还有许多问题没有答案。

definition_zh: 借此；由此；从而
definition_en: by that means, by that act, or as a result of that
core_image: 一根绳子从“那件事”牵到“这个结果”：动作在前，结果在后。
scene: 老城区挂出了禁行标志，空气监测屏上的曲线缓缓下降。The city banned cars from the old quarter, thereby reducing air pollution.
sceneCN: 这里 thereby 是「从而、由此」（第 2 个义项：表示结果）；句意：该市禁止汽车进入老城区，从而使空气污染减少了三分之一。场景要点：禁行标志、无车的石板街、监测屏上的空气质量数字。

pos.zh: 借此；由此；从而（正式书面语）

collocations.zh: 这背后还有一段故事（古语）

derivatives.zh: 凭借之；据此（关系副词）
在其中；于此
对此；附之（正式）
随即；因此（正式）

senses.title: By that means
senses.titleCN: 借此：用那件事作为手段
senses.definition: by means of that action, tool, or arrangement; used to name the instrument that produces a result
senses.definitionCN: 通过那一动作、工具或安排；用于指出产生结果的手段
senses.example: They lowered the price and thereby attracted new customers.
senses.exampleCN: 他们降低了价格，借此吸引了新客户。
senses.why: There is the old locative 'that', and by is the preposition of means. Put together, thereby points to the thing just mentioned as the instrument.
senses.whyCN: there 是古英语的方位指示“那”，by 是表示手段的介词。两者合起来，thereby 就把刚提到的那件事指为工具。

senses.title: As a result of that
senses.titleCN: 由此：结果顺着动作落下
senses.definition: as a consequence of that action or fact, often introducing a participle clause
senses.definitionCN: 作为那一动作或事实的后果，常引导分词从句
senses.example: The rule was simplified, thereby reducing errors.
senses.exampleCN: 规则被简化，从而减少了错误。
senses.why: The same rope now runs from cause to effect rather than from agent to tool. English uses thereby with -ing clauses to mark the result that follows.
senses.whyCN: 同一根绳子现在从原因牵到结果，而不是从行动者牵到工具。英语用 thereby 加分词从句来标记随后出现的结果。

senses.title: Consequently, by that reasoning
senses.titleCN: 因此：按那条推理走下去
senses.definition: therefore, or as a logical consequence of what has just been said
senses.definitionCN: 因此，或作为刚说内容在逻辑上的后果
senses.example: The two events coincided, and thereby seemed connected.
senses.exampleCN: 两件事同时发生，因此看起来似乎有关联。
senses.why: A means can also be a premise: if you accept that, you are led to this. Thereby then works as a formal connector of reasoning rather than of physical action.
senses.whyCN: 手段也可以是前提：接受那一点，就会被引到这里。这时的 thereby 是推理的形式连接词，而不是物理动作的连接。

senses.title: By doing that
senses.titleCN: 借那一动作：方式即手段
senses.definition: by performing that particular act, especially when the act and its effect are one gesture
senses.definitionCN: 通过做出那一特定行为，尤指行为与效果是同一个动作
senses.example: She resigned, thereby avoiding a formal dismissal.
senses.exampleCN: 她辞职了，借此避免了被正式解雇。
senses.why: Here the means is not a tool but an act. Resigning and avoiding dismissal are the same movement seen from two sides, and thereby joins them.
senses.whyCN: 这里的手段不是工具，而是一个行为。辞职与避免解雇是同一动作的两面，thereby 把两面接在一起。

senses.title: By that fact alone
senses.titleCN: 凭那个事实：资格由此而来
senses.definition: by virtue of that fact or status, especially in legal or formal statements of entitlement
senses.definitionCN: 凭借那一事实或身份，尤用于法律或正式的权利陈述
senses.example: A person born there is a citizen, and thereby entitled to a passport.
senses.exampleCN: 在那里出生的人即为公民，并由此有权获得护照。
senses.why: The instrument is now a fact rather than an action. A status carries its consequences automatically, and thereby marks that automatic carry.
senses.whyCN: 工具现在是一个事实，而不是一个动作。身份会自动带来后果，thereby 标记的正是这种自动携带。

senses.title: In that respect
senses.titleCN: 在这一点上：就那方面而言
senses.definition: in that respect or by that provision, used in legal and older formal prose
senses.definitionCN: 在那一点上，或依据那项条款，用于法律与较早的正式文体
senses.example: The clause is void, and thereby the whole contract fails.
senses.exampleCN: 该条款无效，就此而言整份合同失效。
senses.why: This is the limiting use: thereby does not name a cause but marks the respect in which a statement holds. It survives mainly in legal writing.
senses.whyCN: 这是限定用法：thereby 不指出原因，而标记一句话在哪个方面成立。它主要残留在法律写作中。

senses.title: By which (archaic relative use)
senses.definition: by which, used in older English to introduce a relative clause about a means
senses.definitionCN: 凭借之，用于较早英语中引导关于手段的关系从句
senses.example: They built a channel thereby the water might reach the fields.
senses.exampleCN: 他们修了一条渠道，借此水可以到达田里。
senses.why: Before whereby became the standard relative form, thereby could do that work. The modern language has pushed this use to the edge of the grammar.
senses.whyCN: 在 whereby 成为标准关系形式之前，thereby 也能承担这个功能。现代英语已把这种用法推到语法的边缘。

senses.title: The academic result connector
senses.titleCN: 学术连接：分词前的结果标记
senses.definition: a formulaic connector in academic writing, typically followed by a participle to sum up a consequence
senses.definitionCN: 学术写作中的套式连接词，通常后接分词，概括某后果
senses.example: The samples were dried overnight, thereby preventing contamination.
senses.exampleCN: 样品被晾干过夜，从而防止了污染。
senses.why: Modern academic style fixed the pattern thereby + -ing. The old rope between act and result has become a punctuation mark of argument.
senses.whyCN: 现代学术文体固定了 thereby + -ing 的句式。那根连接动作与结果的旧绳子，变成了论证里的标点符号。

intro.en: Thereby is not a Latin word at all. It is an English compound of there, the old locative of 'that', and by, the preposition of means. The two were joined in Old and Middle English and later restricted to formal prose.
intro.cn: thereby 根本不是拉丁词，而是英语复合词：there 是“那”的古方位形式，by 是表示手段的介词。两者在古英语与中古英语中结合，后来被限制在正式书面语中。

items.en: Þǣr was the locative form of 'that', meaning 'there, in that place'. It is the ancestor of modern there and of the there- compounds.
items.cn: þǣr 是“那”的方位形式，意为“在那里”。它是现代 there 以及 there- 系列复合词的祖先。

items.en: Bī meant 'by, near, by means of'. It is the source of modern by and of the instrumental sense in thereby.
items.cn: bī 意为“在旁、靠近、凭借”。它是现代 by 的来源，也是 thereby 中手段义的来源。

items.en: A compound of the two is attested in Old English, though its frequency and exact range are uncertain. It already had the sense 'by that means'.
items.cn: 两者的复合形式在古英语中已有见，但其使用频率与确切范围存疑。它当时已含“借此、由此”之义。

items.en: Middle English therby carried the instrumental and result senses into general use. The spelling varied between ther-, thar-, and there-.
items.cn: 中古英语 therby 把手段义与结果义带入通用语。拼写在 ther-、thar-、there- 之间摇摆。

items.en: The modern spelling thereby settled in the 16th century. As whereby and wherein took over the relative function, thereby narrowed to means and result.
items.cn: 现代拼写 thereby 在十六世纪固定。随着 whereby、wherein 接管关系功能，thereby 缩小到手段与结果两义。

items.en: Today thereby is almost exclusively formal and written. Its most frequent pattern is thereby + -ing, summarizing the consequence of the main clause.
items.cn: 今天 thereby 几乎只用于正式书面语。最常见句式是 thereby + -ing，概括主句的后果。

note.en: The first group is the there- compound family, which is easy to confuse; the second separates connectors that also join cause and result.
note.cn: 第一组是易混淆的 there- 复合词家族；第二组区分同样连接因果的连接词。

entries.definition: by which; it introduces a clause naming the means. It has taken over the relative job that thereby once did.
entries.definitionCN: 凭借之；引导说明手段的从句。它接管了 thereby 曾经承担的关系功能。

entries.definition: in that document, place, or matter. It points inside something already mentioned.
entries.definitionCN: 在其中；在该文件、地点或事情中。它指向前文已提到之物的内部。

entries.definition: for that reason; consequently. It marks inference, while thereby marks means or result.
entries.definitionCN: 因此；所以。它标记推理，而 thereby 标记手段或结果。

entries.definition: immediately after that; as a result of that. It marks sequence in time more than means.
entries.definitionCN: 随即；因此。它更多标记时间上的先后，而非手段。

entries.definition: in this way or as a result. It is the closest formal partner and can replace thereby in many result clauses.
entries.definitionCN: 以这种方式；因此。它是最接近的正式伙伴，在许多结果从句中可替换 thereby。

entries.definition: as a result; therefore. It is a full sentence connector and does not attach to a participle as thereby does.
entries.definitionCN: 结果是；因此。它是完整的句子连接词，不像 thereby 那样接分词。

entries.definition: in a way that fits what has just been said. It adds the idea of adjusting a response.
entries.definitionCN: 相应地；因此。它增加了“调整应对”的意思。

entries.definition: for this reason; from this fact. It is more logical and less instrumental than thereby.
entries.definitionCN: 因此；由此。它比 thereby 更偏逻辑，更少手段意味。

entries.definition: for that reason or in that way. It is the everyday connector that thereby replaces in formal writing.
entries.definitionCN: 所以；这样一来。它是 thereby 在正式写作中替代的日常连接词。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: there 'that' + by 'by means of'. It is an English compound, not a Latin borrowing; the Latin entry list is empty by design.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：there“那”+ by“凭借”。它是英语复合词，不是拉丁借词，因此拉丁词条按实际情况留空。

normal.en: There + by: by that thing you just mentioned.
normal.cn: there + by：凭借你刚提到的那件事。

normal.en: Thereby reducing is the standard academic pattern: action first, result in the participle.
normal.cn: thereby reducing 是标准学术句式：先有动作，结果放在分词里。

normal.en: Whereby does the relative job; thereby does the means-and-result job.
normal.cn: whereby 干关系从句的活；thereby 干手段与结果的活。

normal.en: Thereby is not therefore: one names the instrument, the other names the inference.
normal.cn: thereby 不是 therefore：一个指出工具，一个指出推理。

normal.en: Thereby hangs a tale keeps the oldest flavour: by that fact there is a story.
normal.cn: thereby hangs a tale 保留了最古老的味道：由那件事，引出一段故事。

abstract.en: Thereby is grammar's way of tying an act to its shadow, the result.
abstract.cn: thereby 是语法把动作与它的影子——结果——绑在一起的方式。

abstract.en: A formal word for a simple thing: this, so that.
abstract.cn: 一个正式的词，说的却是极简单的事：这样，所以。

abstract.en: Every thereby hides a claim that the result really did follow.
abstract.cn: 每个 thereby 背后都藏着一个主张：结果确实随之而来。

examples.en: The firm automated its invoices, thereby cutting paperwork by half.
examples.cn: 公司实现了发票自动化，从而把文书工作减少了一半。

examples.en: He missed the deadline, thereby losing the deposit.
examples.cn: 他错过了截止日期，因此损失了定金。

examples.en: The two islands share a language and are thereby often treated as one region.
examples.cn: 这两座岛共享一种语言，因此常被当作一个地区。

dict_mnemonic.text: “得来拜”——得来全靠拜那一下，由此得结果 → thereby 借此、从而

root: 英语本土复合词：there“那”（古英语 þǣr 的方位形式）+ by“凭借、在旁”，合起来表示“借那件事、由此”。无拉丁语来源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of thereby, all one rope: the thing just named is tied to its means, its act, its consequence, its inference, or the respect in which it holds.
sensesIntro.cn: thereby 的八个义项都围绕同一根绳子：把刚提到的事，系到它的手段、行为、后果、推理，或它成立的那个方面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rope running from a named act to the result it drags behind it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根绳子从已被点名的事，牵到它拖在身后的结果。

branches.en: MEANS AND ACT: the instrument can be a tool or a deed, but in both cases it is what you use.
branches.cn: 手段与行为：工具可以是一件物，也可以是一个举动，但都是你所“用”的东西。

branches.en: RESULT: the rope runs forward into a consequence, most visibly in the academic thereby + -ing pattern.
branches.cn: 结果：绳子向前延伸到后果，最明显的就是学术体的 thereby + -ing 句式。

branches.en: INFERENCE AND ENTITLEMENT: from a premise or a status, something follows automatically.
branches.cn: 推理与资格：从一个前提或一种身份，某物自动随之而来。

branches.en: RESPECT: in legal prose the word can mark the aspect in which a statement holds.
branches.cn: 方面：在法律文体中，这个词可以标记一句话在哪个方面成立。

branches.en: RELATIVE USE: the archaic by which shows the compound doing a grammar job later taken by whereby.
branches.cn: 关系用法：古义的“凭借之”显示这个复合词曾承担后来由 whereby 接管的功能。

intro.en: Thereby has no derivational suffix. Its family is the there- compound set, built from there plus a preposition, and a few fixed academic patterns.
intro.cn: thereby 没有派生后缀。它的家族是 there- 复合词系列，由 there 加介词构成，另有若干固定的学术句式。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source. Thereby is a native English compound of Old English þǣr and bī, so the Latin entry list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁语来源。thereby 是古英语 þǣr 与 bī 构成的英语本土复合词，因此拉丁词条列表为空。

items.meaning: by that means or as a result of that
items.meaningCN: 借此；由此；从而（复合副词）
items.example: The ban cut traffic, thereby improving air quality.
items.exampleCN: 禁令减少了交通，从而改善了空气质量。

items.meaningCN: 凭借之；据此（关系复合词）
items.example: They agreed a process whereby disputes go to arbitration.
items.exampleCN: 他们商定了一个程序，据此争端提交仲裁。

items.example: The report and the tables therein are confidential.
items.exampleCN: 报告及其中表格均属机密。

items.example: The parties agreed to the terms and the annexes thereto.
items.exampleCN: 各方同意条款及所附附件。

items.example: The vote passed; thereupon the meeting closed.
items.exampleCN: 表决通过，会议随即结束。

items.example: He was satisfied therewith and signed.

items.meaning: the standard way of stating a result in academic prose
items.meaningCN: 学术写作中陈述结果的标准句式（thereby 后接现在分词）
items.example: The samples were sealed, thereby preventing evaporation.
items.exampleCN: 样品被密封，从而防止了蒸发。

items.meaning: a rarer pattern stating a consequence as a full clause
items.meaningCN: 较罕见的句式，用完整从句陈述后果
items.example: The treaty was signed, thereby the war ended.
items.exampleCN: 条约签署，战争由此结束。

items.meaning: there is a story attached to that fact
items.meaningCN: 这背后还有一段故事（固定文学短语）
items.example: He came by the map honestly; thereby hangs a tale.
items.exampleCN: 他得到那张地图来路正当；这背后还有一段故事。

items.meaning: thereby names the means, therefore names the inference
items.meaningCN: 对比用法：thereby 指手段，therefore 指推理
items.example: He lied, and therefore lost trust; he lied, thereby losing trust.
items.exampleCN: 他撒了谎，因此失去信任；他撒谎，从而失去了信任。

definition_zh: 因此；所以；故
definition_en: for that reason; used to introduce a conclusion drawn from what has just been said
core_image: 两段链条扣在一起，前一段的末端正好接上后一段的起点
scene: 报告的最后一页列出了全部数据，结论顺理成章地跟着出现。The pass was closed by snow; therefore the convoy took the longer road.
sceneCN: 这里 therefore 是「因此、所以」（第 1 个义项：表示由前文推出的结论）；句意给出由数据推出结论的典型场景。

pos.zh: 因此；所以；故（连接性副词，引出由前文推出的结论）

derivatives.zh: 借此；由此（同构复合词，fore 换成 by）
为此（法律用语，与 therefore 的构词成分相同）
其中（同构复合词）
附于该处（法律用语）
其；由此（法律用语）
为何；原因（where + fore 的同构形式）

senses.title: For that reason
senses.definition: used to introduce a result that the previous statement provides the reason for
senses.definitionCN: 引出结果，而前面的陈述给出这一结果的理由
senses.example: The road was closed; therefore we took the longer route.
senses.exampleCN: 道路封闭了，因此我们走了更远的那条路。
senses.why: Therefore is there plus fore, for that: the word points back at the stated cause and presents what follows as owed to it.
senses.whyCN: therefore 是 there 加 fore「为此」：它回指已说出的原因，并把后文呈现为由那个原因所欠下的。

senses.title: The inevitable step in an argument
senses.titleCN: 论证中必然推出的结论
senses.definition: used in logic where the conclusion cannot be false if the premises are true
senses.definitionCN: 用于逻辑，当前提为真时结论不可能为假
senses.example: All men are mortal; Socrates is a man; therefore Socrates is mortal.
senses.exampleCN: 人皆有死；苏格拉底是人；因此苏格拉底有死。
senses.why: In a syllogism the word marks the forced last line, the point at which the premises hand over their conclusion.
senses.whyCN: 在三段论里，这个词标出被迫写下的最后一行，也就是前提交出结论的那一点。

senses.title: The conclusion of a proof
senses.definition: used in mathematics to introduce a result derived from earlier steps
senses.definitionCN: 数学中用于引出由前面步骤得到的结果
senses.example: The two triangles are congruent; therefore their angles are equal.
senses.exampleCN: 两个三角形全等，因此它们的角相等。
senses.why: Proof writing needs a visible hinge between the derivation and the result, and this is that hinge.
senses.whyCN: 证明写作需要在推导与结果之间有一个看得见的铰链，这个词就是那个铰链。

senses.title: The formal hence of legal prose
senses.definition: used in formal and legal writing to state a required consequence
senses.definitionCN: 在正式与法律文字中陈述必须产生的后果
senses.example: The defendant failed to appear; therefore the court proceeded.
senses.exampleCN: 被告未出庭，故法庭继续审理。
senses.why: Statutes chain a condition to a consequence, and the older register of the word suits that chain of obligation.
senses.whyCN: 法条把条件与后果串起来，而这个词较古的语体正适合这条义务链。

senses.title: For that purpose, in older English
senses.definition: archaic: for that purpose or to that end
senses.definitionCN: 古旧义：为了那个目的、朝向那个目标
senses.example: He laboured therefore that the work might be finished.
senses.exampleCN: 他为此辛勤劳作，好把那件工作完成。
senses.why: Fore once meant for or on account of, so the compound could carry purpose as well as cause; modern English keeps mainly the causal sense.
senses.whyCN: fore 旧有「为了、由于」之义，因此这个复合词既能表目的也能表原因；现代英语主要保留因果义。

senses.title: The close of a rebuttal
senses.definition: used to close an argument after the evidence has been weighed
senses.definitionCN: 在证据权衡完毕后用来收束论证
senses.example: The evidence is incomplete; therefore the claim cannot stand.
senses.exampleCN: 证据不完整，因此这一主张不能成立。
senses.why: Debate ends by naming what the audience must accept, and the word converts a review of evidence into a verdict.
senses.whyCN: 辩论以点明听众必须接受什么来收尾，这个词把对证据的回顾转成裁决。

senses.title: The inference in an experiment
senses.definition: used in reports to state what the data allow the authors to infer
senses.definitionCN: 在报告中陈述数据让作者能推出什么
senses.example: The readings were consistent; therefore the model was accepted.
senses.exampleCN: 读数一致，因此该模型被接受。
senses.why: Scientific style separates observation from inference, and the word marks the crossing point.
senses.whyCN: 科学文体把观察与推论分开，这个词标出跨越的那一点。

senses.title: The summing up in teaching
senses.definition: used in explanation to gather the previous points into one conclusion
senses.definitionCN: 在讲解中把前面的要点收拢成一个结论
senses.example: Therefore, the plan needs revision before the next stage.
senses.exampleCN: 因此，这项计划在进入下一阶段之前需要修订。
senses.why: Teaching needs a marker that says the scattered facts now add up, which is the conversational use of the same hinge.
senses.whyCN: 教学需要一个标记说「零散的事实到此合成一个结论」，这是同一个铰链的口语用法。

intro.en: Therefore is an English compound of there and fore, an old word for before or for that. It is Germanic, not Latin, and the Latin ergo is a counterpart rather than a source. The direct source is clear; the first date is approximate.
intro.cn: therefore 是英语复合词，由 there 与 fore 构成，fore 是表示「在前、为此」的古词。它属日耳曼语而非拉丁语，拉丁语 ergo 只是对应词而非来源。直接来源清楚，首见年代为约数。

items.en: There comes from Old English thær, the locative form meaning in that place, later extended to that point in speech.
items.cn: there 来自古英语 thær，本为「在那个地方」的处所形式，后来扩展到言语中的「那一点」。

items.en: Fore meant before or in front, and in phrases it could mean for that or on account of that.
items.cn: fore 意为在前，在短语中也可表「为了那个、由于那个」。

items.en: The two parts join as therfore in the Middle English period, keeping the pointing function of there.
items.cn: 两部分在中古英语时期合为 therfore，保留了 there 的回指功能。

items.en: Sixteenth-century prose fixes therefore as the standard marker of a conclusion, beside the older thus and hence.
items.cn: 十六世纪的印本散文把 therefore 固定为结论标记，与较早的 thus、hence 并列。

items.en: Modern English keeps therefore for logical consequence and therefor, a different spelling, for legal purpose.
items.cn: 现代英语用 therefore 表逻辑后果，而用拼写不同的 therefor 表法律上的目的。

note.en: The first group shares the there plus fore pattern and includes the look-alike therefor. The second group names conclusions and reasons, and includes consequently and subsequently, which differ in whether causation is claimed.
note.cn: 第一组共享 there + fore 的构词模式，并包含形近的 therefor。第二组表示结论与理由，其中 consequently 与 subsequently 的区别在于是否主张因果。

entries.definition: For that purpose, a legal spelling with one r fewer than therefore; it is not a misspelling of the adverb.
entries.definitionCN: 为此目的，法律用语，比 therefore 少一个 r；它不是 therefore 的拼写错误。

entries.definition: By that means, with by in place of fore.
entries.definitionCN: 借此、由此，用 by 代替 fore。

entries.definition: Of that or of it, in legal and formal writing.
entries.definitionCN: 其、由此，用于法律与正式文字。

entries.definition: In that place or in that document.
entries.definitionCN: 在其中、在该文件之内。

entries.definition: For what reason, built on where instead of there, and preserved in legal and poetic prose.
entries.definitionCN: 为何、由于什么，用 where 而非 there 构成，存于法律与诗歌文字中。

entries.definition: In this way or as a result, often marking a conclusion in formal prose.
entries.definitionCN: 如此、因此，正式文字中常作结论标记。

entries.definition: From this fact, as a consequence; also from this time.
entries.definitionCN: 由此、因此；也表「从此时起」。

entries.definition: As a result; stronger on causation and weaker on argument than therefore.
entries.definitionCN: 结果上；比 therefore 更强调因果，论证色彩较弱。

entries.definition: In a way that matches what has just been said, often of action taken.
entries.definitionCN: 按照刚说的情况而行事。

entries.definition: Afterwards in time only; it never supplies the causal link that therefore carries.
entries.definitionCN: 只表时间上的随后；它从不提供 therefore 所带的因果连接。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real there plus fore pattern and keep therefore apart from subsequently and consequently.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的 there + fore 构词模式，并把 therefore 与 subsequently、consequently 区分开。

normal.en: There points back, fore means for: therefore is for that, pointing at the reason just given.
normal.cn: there 回指，fore 意为「为了」：therefore 就是「为此」，指向刚给出的理由。

normal.en: In a syllogism the word is the last line, the place where premises hand over their conclusion.
normal.cn: 在三段论里，这个词是最后一行，是前提交出结论的地方。

normal.en: Mathematicians write therefore where the proof turns from work to result.
normal.cn: 数学家在证明从推导转向结果的地方写 therefore。

normal.en: Then there is time, therefore is cause: one is a clock, the other a hinge.
normal.cn: then 是时间，therefore 是原因：一个是钟，一个是铰链。

normal.en: Lawyers keep therefor with one r for purpose, and therefore with two for conclusions.
normal.cn: 律师用少一个 r 的 therefor 表目的，用两个 r 的 therefore 表结论。

abstract.en: A conclusion is a debt the earlier sentence has already agreed to pay.
abstract.cn: 结论是前一句话已经答应偿付的一笔债。

abstract.en: Saying therefore is claiming that nothing else could have followed.
abstract.cn: 说「因此」，就是在主张不可能有别的结果。

abstract.en: The word works because two sentences can be made to touch.
abstract.cn: 这个词能起作用，只因为两句话可以被接得贴在一起。

examples.en: The sample was contaminated; therefore the results were discarded.
examples.cn: 样品被污染，因此结果作废。

examples.en: The two accounts disagree; therefore at least one is wrong.
examples.cn: 两种说法互相矛盾，因此至少有一种是错的。

examples.en: The bridge carries no traffic; therefore repairs can wait.
examples.cn: 这座桥不通车，因此修缮可以推迟。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「戴尔福」，there 指「那件事」，fore 指「为了」：为了那件事，所以如此

root: 英语复合词 there + fore（fore 古义为「在前、为了」）。属日耳曼语来源，拉丁语 ergo「因此」只是对应词而非词源，故不列拉丁同族。现代英语用 therefore 表逻辑后果，用拼写 therefor 表法律上的目的。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses share one hinge: something has been stated, and what follows is presented as owed to it. The setting changes from daily reasoning to syllogism, proof, statute, archaic purpose, rebuttal, experiment and classroom summary.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项共享一个铰链：某事已被陈述，后文被呈现为由它欠下的。场景从日常推理换到三段论、证明、法条、古旧的目的义、辩驳、实验与课堂总结。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two chains joined so that the end of one meets the beginning of the other.
core.cn: 核心意象：两条链条相接，前一条的末端正好扣住后一条的起点。

branches.en: THE EVERYDAY CAUSE: a result the previous sentence has already paid for.
branches.cn: 日常原因：前一语句已经付过账的结果。

branches.en: THE FORCED LINE: the last step of a syllogism, and the closing line of a proof.
branches.cn: 被迫的一行：三段论的最后一步，以及证明的收束句。

branches.en: THE STATUTE: a condition in law handing over a required consequence.
branches.cn: 法条：法律中的条件交出必须承担的后果。

branches.en: THE OLD PURPOSE: for that end, a sense modern English has mostly dropped.
branches.cn: 古旧目的义：为了那个目标，现代英语已大体舍弃。

branches.en: THE VERDICT: closing a rebuttal, crossing from data to inference, and summing up a lesson.
branches.cn: 裁决：收束辩驳、从数据跨到推论，以及总结一堂课。

intro.en: Therefore is not a suffixed word but a compound of there and fore. English reuses the same frame in thereby, therein, thereof and the legal therefor, and wherefore swaps where for there.
intro.cn: therefore 不是加后缀的词，而是 there 与 fore 的复合词。英语用同一框架造出 thereby、therein、thereof 与法律用语的 therefor，wherefore 则把 where 换到 there 的位置。

latinIntro.en: The word is Germanic and has no Latin cognate, so no Latin entries are listed. Latin ergo and igitur are counterparts in meaning only.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词属日耳曼语，没有拉丁同族词，因此不列拉丁词条。拉丁语 ergo 与 igitur 只是在意义上对应。

items.meaning: in that place; at that point
items.meaningCN: 在那个地方；在那一点上
items.example: The first half of the compound is the pointing finger.
items.exampleCN: 复合词的前半截就是那根指过去的手指。

items.example: The second half supplies the sense of on account of.
items.exampleCN: 后半截提供「由于、为了」的意思。

items.example: The compound is fixed by the sixteenth century.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词在十六世纪固定下来。

items.example: Legal drafters keep the shorter spelling for purpose.
items.exampleCN: 法律起草者用较短的拼写表目的。

items.example: The frame swaps fore for by and keeps the pointing.
items.exampleCN: 这个框架把 fore 换成 by，回指功能不变。

items.example: The same slot also takes a preposition of place.
items.exampleCN: 同一个位置也可以放表示处所的前置词。

items.example: Contracts use the form to point back at a defined item.
items.exampleCN: 合同用它回指已定义的事项。

items.example: The interrogative version of the same frame survives in legal prose.
items.exampleCN: 同一框架的疑问版本存活于法律文字中。

items.example: It is the older rival that therefore largely displaced.
items.exampleCN: 它是 therefore 大体上取代了的较早对手。

items.example: It marks manner as well as conclusion, which therefore does not.
items.exampleCN: 它既标方式也标结论，而 therefore 不标方式。

definition_zh: 温度计；体温计
definition_en: an instrument for measuring temperature, usually a thin glass tube with a scale
core_image: 细玻璃管里的水银柱随冷热升降：热度被翻译成了刻度
scene: 护士把小玻璃管从孩子腋下取出，眯眼看刻度。The nurse shook down the thermometer before taking his temperature again.
sceneCN: 这里 thermometer 是「体温计」（第 2 个义项：用于量体温的温度计）；句意：护士先甩下体温计的水银柱，再重新量体温。

collocations.phrase: take one's temperature with a thermometer

derivatives.zh: 温度计的；与温度测量有关的（thermometer 加形容词后缀 -ic）
温度测量法；测温学（thermometer 的学科化名词）
恒温器（同用希腊词根 therm，指自动调温装置）
热的；保暖的（同出希腊 thermos，指与热有关的）

senses.title: An instrument for measuring temperature
senses.titleCN: 温度计：测量冷热的仪器
senses.definition: a device that measures how hot or cold something is, usually with a scale and a liquid column or a sensor
senses.definitionCN: 测量物体冷热程度的装置，通常带刻度和液柱或传感器
senses.example: The oven has a built-in thermometer to keep the heat steady.
senses.exampleCN: 烤箱自带温度计，可以保持温度稳定。
senses.why: Greek thermos means heat and metron means measure: the word literally says a measurer of heat.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 thermos 意为「热」，metron 意为「测量」：这个词字面意思就是「热的量具」。

senses.title: A clinical thermometer for body heat
senses.definition: a small thermometer used to take a person's temperature, often placed under the tongue or arm
senses.definitionCN: 用于量人体温的小温度计，常放在舌下或腋下
senses.example: The thermometer showed a fever of thirty-nine degrees.
senses.exampleCN: 体温计显示出三十九度的高烧。
senses.why: When the measurer of heat is applied to a patient, the instrument borrows the name of its most familiar task.
senses.whyCN: 当量热的仪器用到病人身上时，仪器便借用了它最熟悉的任务之名。

senses.title: A gauge of mood or trend
senses.titleCN: 晴雨表：比喻冷热的指针
senses.definition: something that shows or reflects the level of feeling, activity, or public opinion, like a temperature reading
senses.definitionCN: 反映情绪、活动或舆论高低的指标，如同温度读数
senses.example: Sales figures are a good thermometer of customer trust.
senses.exampleCN: 销售数据是顾客信任度的一支晴雨表。
senses.why: Because the instrument turns invisible heat into a visible number, any measure that makes a hidden mood visible can be called by its name.
senses.whyCN: 因为这仪器把看不见的热变成看得见的数字，任何把隐藏情绪显形化的度量都可借用其名。

intro.en: Thermometer is a pure Greek compound: thermos, hot, plus metron, measure. It was coined in the scientific age of the seventeenth century, when measuring heat became a discipline.
intro.cn: thermometer 是纯希腊语复合词：thermos「热」加 metron「测量」。它诞生于十七世纪的科学时代，那时测量热度成为一门学问。

items.en: Thermos meant warm or hot in ancient Greek, and metron meant a measure. Both were common building blocks of learned words.
items.cn: 古希腊语 thermos 意为「温热的」，metron 意为「度量」。两者都是学术用词的常用构件。

items.en: The instrument itself appeared in the seventeenth century, after Galileo's thermoscope showed heat by the rise of water in a tube.
items.cn: 这种仪器出现于十七世纪；此前伽利略的验温器已能用管中水柱的升降显示热度。

items.en: The word thermometer is first recorded in English in the early seventeenth century, as scientists argued about who invented the device.
items.cn: thermometer 一词于十七世纪初见于英语记录，当时科学家还在争论谁发明了这种仪器。

items.en: French thermomtre shows the same learned coinage, and the word travelled between the two languages during the scientific revolution.
items.cn: 法语 thermomètre 是同样的学术造词，科学革命期间该词在英法两种语言间往来。

items.en: The clinical sense narrowed in the nineteenth century, when taking a patient's temperature became routine medical practice.
items.cn: 十九世纪，随量体温成为常规医疗，该词 narrowed 到体温计一义。

items.en: Modern use extends the word to figurative gauges of opinion and mood, keeping the image of a visible reading of hidden heat.
items.cn: 现代用法把这个词延伸到舆论与情绪的比喻性指标，保留了「把隐热显形」的意象。

note.en: The first group holds the therm- word family from Greek; the second gathers instruments and measures that share its job.
note.cn: 第一组是源自希腊语的 therm- 词族；第二组是与它功能相近的量具类词。

entries.definition: a device that keeps temperature steady by switching heating on and off
entries.definitionCN: 恒温器：通过开关加热来保持温度稳定的装置

entries.definition: relating to heat, as in thermal underwear or a thermal spring
entries.definitionCN: 热的；保暖的，如 thermal underwear 保暖内衣

entries.definition: a vacuum flask that keeps drinks hot or cold; originally a trade name
entries.definitionCN: 保温瓶；源自同一词根，原为商标名

entries.definition: an instrument that measures amount or level, such as a fuel gauge
entries.definitionCN: 计量表；量规，如油量表

entries.definition: an instrument measuring air pressure, often used figuratively for a sign of change
entries.definitionCN: 气压计；常喻指形势变化的标志

entries.definition: the marked series of numbers on a measuring instrument
entries.definitionCN: 刻度；量具上的标度系列

normalIntro.en: Real roots: Greek thermos for heat and metron for measure, plus the therm- family in English.
normalIntro.cn: 真实词根：希腊语 thermos「热」、metron「测量」，以及英语中的 therm- 词族。

normal.en: Thermos means hot, metron means measure: thermometer is a heat measurer.
normal.cn: thermos 是热，metron 是测量：thermometer 就是量热的仪器。

normal.en: A thermostat holds temperature; a thermometer only tells it.
normal.cn: thermostat 控温，thermometer 只报温。

normal.en: Thermal underwear and a thermos flask both keep heat where you want it.
normal.cn: 保暖内衣和保温瓶都把热留在你想留的地方。

normal.en: Under the tongue, under the arm: the clinical thermometer waits for your heat.
normal.cn: 舌下、腋下：体温计在等你的热度。

normal.en: Sales as a thermometer of trust: invisible feelings become visible numbers.
normal.cn: 销量是信任的晴雨表：看不见的情绪变成看得见的数字。

abstract.en: A thin glass tube that translates heat into a number.
abstract.cn: 一根把热度翻译成数字的细玻璃管。

abstract.en: The little line that climbs is the fever's confession.
abstract.cn: 那根上升的小线，是发烧的供词。

abstract.en: Every organization keeps a thermometer stuck in the mood of its people.
abstract.cn: 每个组织都把一支温度计插在成员的情绪里。

examples.en: She put the thermometer under her tongue and waited.
examples.cn: 她把体温计放在舌下等着。

examples.en: Check the outdoor thermometer before you water the plants.
examples.cn: 浇水前先看看室外温度计。

examples.en: Thermal cameras work where a normal thermometer cannot reach.
examples.cn: 热成像仪能派上普通温度计到不了用场的地方。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑟莫米特」——瑟瑟发抖怕冷热，拿「米尺」来量一量 → thermometer 温度计

root: 希腊语 thermos「热」+ metron「测量」→ 十七世纪科学造词，直译「量热器」；同族词 thermostat、thermal、thermos 均出 therm- 词根。

sensesIntro.en: Thermometer names the heat measurer itself, then the clinical version for body temperature, and finally any visible gauge of hidden feeling.
sensesIntro.cn: thermometer 先指量热仪器本身，再指量体温的临床款，最后泛指任何把隐形情绪显形化的指标。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin tube turning invisible heat into a visible number.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根细管把看不见的热变成看得见的数字。

branches.en: The instrument that measures hot and cold.
branches.cn: 测量冷热的仪器本身。

branches.en: The small version that reads a patient's fever.
branches.cn: 读取病人体温的小型版本。

branches.en: The borrowed name for any measure of mood or trend.
branches.cn: 借来指称情绪或趋势度量的名字。

branches.en: Both senses rest on one image: heat made readable.
branches.cn: 两个义项立于同一意象：让热变得可读。

branches.en: The figurative sense keeps the picture of a needle climbing with feeling.
branches.cn: 比喻义保留指针随情绪攀升的画面。

intro.en: Thermometer is built from two Greek roots, thermos and metron, and anchors a large therm- family of learned English words.
intro.cn: thermometer 由两个希腊词根 thermos 与 metron 构成，并支撑起英语中庞大的学术词族 therm-。

latinIntro.en: The source is Greek rather than Latin; the learned family below shares the Greek root thermos, so the strictly Latin list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 词源是希腊语而非拉丁语；下表学术词族共享希腊词根 thermos，因此严格意义上的拉丁词条留空。

items.example: Thermos means hot in Greek.
items.exampleCN: Thermos 在希腊语中意为热。

items.example: A speedometer measures speed.

items.meaningCN: 温度计（连接元音 o 接合两个词根）
items.example: Read the thermometer at eye level.
items.exampleCN: 读温度计时要平视刻度。

items.meaningCN: 恒温器（stat 出自希腊语「站立、固定」）
items.example: The thermostat keeps the room at twenty degrees.
items.exampleCN: 恒温器把房间保持在二十度。

items.meaning: the physics of heat and energy
items.meaningCN: 热力学（热 + 力的学问）
items.example: Thermodynamics governs engines.

items.meaningCN: 热的；保暖的（形容词后缀 -al）
items.example: Thermal socks keep feet warm.

items.meaningCN: 速度计（与 thermometer 平行的 -meter 构词）
items.example: The speedometer needle jumped.
items.exampleCN: 速度计的指针跳了一下。

items.meaningCN: 气压计（baro 出自希腊语「重量」）
items.example: A falling barometer often means rain.
items.exampleCN: 气压下降常意味着下雨。

items.example: Accurate thermometry matters in hospitals.
items.exampleCN: 精确测温在医院至关重要。

definition_zh: 他们；她们；它们；泛指的人（如 everyone...they）
definition_en: the people, animals, or things already mentioned, or people in general when the exact person is unknown
core_image: 一群人站在远处，你指向他们：不是你，不是我，是他们
scene: 孩子们在操场上踢球，喊声传到教室。They are still playing football after the last bell.
sceneCN: 这里 they 是「他们」（第 1 个义项：指前文提到的一群人）；句意：放学铃响后他们还在踢球。

pos.zh: 泛指某人；那个人们（单数用法）

derivatives.zh: 他们（宾格；与 they 同属一个代词词形变化表）
他们的（所有格；与 there、they're 同音，注意区分）
他们的（东西）（名词性物主代词，可独立使用）
他们自己（反身代词，由 them 加 selves 构成）

senses.title: The people already mentioned
senses.titleCN: 他们；她们：指前文说过的那些人
senses.definition: the group of people, animals, or things that has just been spoken or written about, as subject of the verb
senses.definitionCN: 刚被提到的人群、动物或事物，在句中作主语
senses.example: The students finished the exam, and they went out to celebrate.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们考完试，就出去庆祝了。
senses.why: A sentence already names its people once; they steps in so the names need not be repeated.
senses.whyCN: 一句话只需把人名点一次；they 替补上场，省得反复报名字。

senses.title: Things or animals
senses.definition: used for animals or things in the plural, or for a single animal whose sex is unknown
senses.definitionCN: 用于复数的动物或事物，或性别不明的单个动物
senses.example: The books arrived late, but they were all undamaged.
senses.exampleCN: 书到得晚了，但全都完好无损。
senses.why: The old plural pointing word covers every third-person plural that is not us or you, without asking about species.
senses.whyCN: 这个古老的复数指示词包揽一切既非我们也非你们的第三人称复数，不问物种。

senses.title: People in general
senses.definition: people in general, or an unspecified person, especially after words like everyone, somebody, or nobody
senses.definitionCN: 泛指一般人，或身份不明的某个人，尤其跟在 everyone、somebody、nobody 之后
senses.example: If anybody calls, tell them I am in a meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 如果有人打电话，告诉那人我在开会。
senses.why: When the exact person is unknown or unimportant, English borrows the plural form because it carries no marking of gender.
senses.whyCN: 当具体是谁不重要时，英语借用复数形式，因为它不带任何性别标记。

senses.title: A single person of unspecified gender
senses.definition: one person whose gender is not stated or is not relevant, as in a doctor...they
senses.definitionCN: 性别未说明或无关紧要的某一个人，如 a doctor...they
senses.example: A good teacher listens before they speak.
senses.exampleCN: 好老师先倾听再开口。
senses.why: Written English since the Middle Ages has allowed they for one unknown person; modern usage has revived and extended this old right.
senses.whyCN: 自中古英语起，书面语就允许用 they 指身份不明者；现代用法复兴并扩展了这一古老权利。

intro.en: They is a Norse loan. Old English had hie for they, but the Scandinavian settlers' word their, from the same ancient stem as that, pushed it out almost everywhere.
intro.cn: they 是古诺斯语借词。古英语本来用 hie 表示「他们」，但斯堪的纳维亚移民带来的、与 that 同源的 their 一词几乎把它挤出了所有方言。

items.en: Old Norse Their meant they, built on the demonstrative stem tha- that also produced the and that.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 Their 意为「他们」，建立在指示词干 tha- 之上；the、that 也出自同一词干。

items.en: Old English used hie, with forms like heora for their and him for them; the system was starting to blur by sound change.
items.cn: 古英语用 hie 表「他们」，所有格是 heora，与格是 him；语音演变已让这套代词开始混淆。

items.en: In the Danelaw, Norse settlers spoke a close cousin of English; their pronouns were easier to tell apart and were adopted in the north first.
items.cn: 在丹麦法区，诺斯移民说的语言与英语是近亲；他们的代词更易分辨，于是在北部最先被采用。

items.en: Middle English spread they, their and them from north to south, replacing most of the old hie forms by the fifteenth century.
items.cn: 中古英语时期，they、their、them 由北向南推广，到十五世纪基本取代了旧的 hie 系列形式。

items.en: Standard English settled the paradigm they, them, their, theirs, and later added the singular use now written about as singular they.
items.cn: 标准英语固定了 they、them、their、theirs 的范式，后来又发展出如今被称为 singular they 的单数用法。

note.en: The first group lines up the same-sounding pronoun pair; the second collects the other personal pronouns of English.
note.cn: 第一组是同音易混的代词；第二组是英语其他人称代词。

entries.definition: belonging to them; same sound as they and there, different job
entries.definitionCN: 他们的（所属格）；与 they、there 同音而职能不同

entries.definition: in that place; a pointing adverb that sounds the same as their and they're
entries.definitionCN: 在那里；与 their、they're 同音的地点副词

entries.definition: the old singular object form of thou; spelled almost like they
entries.definitionCN: 古语「你」的宾格（thou 的宾格），拼写与 they 相近

entries.definition: the speaker and others; the pronoun on the near side of the conversation
entries.definitionCN: 我们；谈话中靠近说话者一方的人称代词

entries.definition: the person or people spoken to; singular and plural in one form
entries.definitionCN: 你；你们（单复数同形）

entries.definition: persons in general; a full noun that can replace they in formal writing
entries.definitionCN: 人们；正式文体中可替代泛指 they 的名词

normalIntro.en: Real hooks: the Norse origin, the full paradigm they them their theirs, and the sound-alike trio.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：古诺斯语来源、they them their theirs 完整范式、以及同音三兄弟。

normal.en: They came from the Vikings: Old Norse their replaced the old English hie.
normal.cn: they 来自北欧海盗：古诺斯语 their 取代了古英语的 hie。

normal.en: The paradigm: they do, them see, their book, theirs is red, themselves.
normal.cn: 范式：they 作主语，them 作宾语，their 表所属，theirs 独立用，themselves 反身。

normal.en: They, their, there, they're: four spellings, three sounds, endless exam questions.
normal.cn: they、their、there、they're：四种拼法，三个读音，考题无穷。

normal.en: They say is how English quotes the crowd without naming it.
normal.cn: they say 是英语引用「大家说」而不点名的方式。

normal.en: Everybody...they: the singular they has been legal in English for six centuries.
normal.cn: everybody 后接 they：单数 they 在英语里合法了六个世纪。

abstract.en: They is the crowd seen from a distance, one shape for every mixture.
abstract.cn: they 是远远望见的人群，无论怎样混合都只用一个形状。

abstract.en: A pronoun is a loan of attention: you lend your name once, and they carries it.
abstract.cn: 代词是注意力的借贷：名字只需出借一次，they 替你背着它走。

abstract.en: When we do not know who, English shrugs and says they.
abstract.cn: 当不知道是谁时，英语耸耸肩说 they。

examples.en: They built the bridge in two years.
examples.cn: 他们用两年建成了那座桥。

examples.en: My keys were on the table, but they are gone now.
examples.cn: 我的钥匙原在桌上，但现在不见了。

examples.en: Everyone should bring their own lunch, and they should label it.
examples.cn: 每个人都该自带午餐，并写上名字。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞」——一群人喊「瑞」打招呼，他们来了 → they 他们

root: 古诺斯语 Their「他们」（指示词干 tha- 的复数）→ 经丹麦法区进入中古英语，取代古英语 hie；与 the、that 同源，属日耳曼指示词系统。

sensesIntro.en: They first replaces a named group, then covers plural animals and things, and finally serves for people in general and for one person whose gender does not matter.
sensesIntro.cn: they 先替代已点名的人群，再涵盖复数的动物与事物，最后服务泛指的人们与性别不明的单个人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a group standing at a distance, pointed at with one short word.
core.cn: 核心意象：站在远处的人群，用一个短词指过去。

branches.en: The core job: subject pronoun for a known group.
branches.cn: 核心职能：为已知人群作主语代词。

branches.en: The plural reaches animals and things without asking.
branches.cn: 复数用法覆盖动物与事物，不问种类。

branches.en: Generic they quotes the crowd: they say.
branches.cn: 泛指 they 引述人群：they say。

branches.en: Singular they fills the gap left by he and she.
branches.cn: 单数 they 填补 he 与 she 留下的空位。

branches.en: Both extensions come from the same neutrality: no gender, no species, no fuss.
branches.cn: 两项扩展出于同一中立性：不分性别、不分物种、毫无芥蒂。

intro.en: They has no derivational family in the usual sense; its paradigm of forms and its there- sound-alikes are the real system to master.
intro.cn: they 没有常规意义上的派生词族；真正要掌握的是它的词形范式与 there- 同音词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source; they is Norse-Germanic, so the Latin entry list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: they 没有拉丁语来源，属诺斯-日耳曼系统，因此拉丁词条留空。

items.meaning: the people or things already mentioned
items.example: They arrived early.
I met them at the station.
Their car is blue.

items.meaningCN: 他们的（东西）（名词性所有格）
items.example: That seat is theirs.

items.meaning: they, back on their own selves
items.example: They cooked the meal themselves.
I give thee thanks.

items.meaningCN: 这些（this 的复数，同属 tha- 词干家族）
items.example: These are my notes.
Those are your gloves.

definition_zh: 厚的；粗的；浓的；浓密的；愚蠢的；雾重的
definition_en: having a large distance between two sides, densely packed, not flowing easily, or slow to understand
core_image: 两大平面之间塞满了东西：一掌压不下去的厚
scene: 大雪整夜未停，清晨推开院门，积雪没了脚踝。The snow lay thick on the garden path.
sceneCN: 这里 thick 是「厚厚地积着、浓密」（第 3 个义项：密集铺满）；句意：花园小径上积雪很厚。

derivatives.zh: 厚厚地；浓密地（thick 加副词后缀 -ly）
厚度；浓度；层（thick 加名词后缀 -ness）
使变厚；变浓（thick 加动词后缀 -en）
增稠剂（thicken 加施动者后缀 -er）

senses.title: Large between two surfaces
senses.definition: having a large distance between two opposite sides or surfaces
senses.definitionCN: 两个相对的面之间距离较大
senses.example: She wore a thick coat against the winter wind.
senses.exampleCN: 她穿上厚外套抵御寒风。
senses.why: The basic measure: a slab is thick when its two faces stand far apart, so the word names size across rather than along.
senses.whyCN: 最基本的量度：一块板的两面离得远就叫厚，这个词量的是横向的尺寸而不是纵向的。

senses.title: Densely packed together
senses.definition: growing or standing close together in large numbers
senses.definitionCN: 大量生长或聚集在一起，间距很小
senses.example: The forest is thick with pines and moss.
senses.exampleCN: 森林里松树和苔藓长得很密。
senses.why: When many things fill a space so closely that light struggles through, the crowding itself feels like thickness.
senses.whyCN: 当许多东西挤满一个空间、连光都难以穿过时，这种拥挤本身就让人感觉「厚」。

senses.title: Not flowing easily
senses.definition: (of a liquid) not flowing easily because it is dense or heavy
senses.definitionCN: 指液体浓稠、不易流动
senses.example: The sauce boiled down until it was thick and glossy.
senses.exampleCN: 酱汁熬到浓稠发亮。
senses.why: A dense liquid resists movement the way a thick plank resists bending, so the same word covers both blocks and broths.
senses.whyCN: 浓稠的液体抗拒流动，就像厚板抗拒弯折，同一个词便同时盖住了板块与汤汁。

senses.title: Slow to understand
senses.definition: (informal) not quick to understand, a little stupid
senses.definitionCN: （口语）理解得慢，有点迟钝
senses.example: Don't be thick, the answer is staring at you.
senses.exampleCN: 别犯迷糊了，答案就明摆在你眼前。
senses.why: An idea slides off a head as light slides off fog; the dense mind, like dense air, lets little through.
senses.whyCN: 想法滑不过一个脑袋，正如光穿不透浓雾；迟钝的头脑与浓重的空气一样，透不进多少东西。

senses.title: Heavy and hard to see through
senses.definition: (of fog, smoke, or air) heavy and difficult to see or breathe through
senses.definitionCN: 指雾、烟或空气浓重，难以看透或呼吸
senses.example: Thick smoke rolled down the stairwell.
senses.exampleCN: 浓烟涌下楼梯间。
senses.why: Smoke and fog fill space the way timber fills a wall, so seeing through them becomes as hard as drilling through a board.
senses.whyCN: 烟雾像木头填满墙壁一样填满空间，看穿它便变得像钻穿木板一样困难。

intro.en: Thick is a native Germanic word, old at the root: it goes back to an ancient word for densely pressed or crowded, and its cousins are found across the Germanic languages.
intro.cn: thick 是日耳曼本土词，词根十分古老：它追溯到表示「挤压密集」的古代词形，同源词遍布各日耳曼语言。

items.en: The common Germanic root is Theku, generally reconstructed as meaning thick, pressed close, or crowded; it had no Latin relatives.
items.cn: 公认的日耳曼词根一般重构为 Theku，意为「厚的、挤压紧密的、拥挤的」；它没有拉丁语同源词。

items.en: Old English Thicce already carried the main senses: solid in size, crowded in number, and heavy in texture.
items.cn: 古英语 Thicce 已具备主要义项：体积厚实、数量密集、质地浓重。

items.en: Norse Pokkr, a close cousin, reinforced the northern forms of the adjective.
items.cn: 古诺斯语的近亲词 Pokkr 加强了这一形容词在北方的形式。

items.en: Middle English thikke spread the figurative uses, and the adverb thikke(or thick) without -ly entered common speech.
items.cn: 中古英语 thikke 发展出比喻用法，无 -ly 的副词形式也进入日常口语。

items.en: Modern English fixed thick, thickly and thickness, and the idioms through thick and thin and thick as thieves gave the word a social flavour.
items.cn: 现代英语固定了 thick、thickly 与 thickness，习语 through thick and thin 和 thick as thieves 又给这个词添了人情味。

note.en: The first group holds the thick word family; the second compares adjectives of density and slowness.
note.cn: 第一组是 thick 词族；第二组比较表示密度与迟钝的形容词。

entries.definitionCN: 使变厚；变浓（thick 的动词形式）

entries.definition: the measure of how thick something is
entries.definitionCN: 厚度；浓度（thick 的名词形式）

entries.definition: a clever act meant to deceive; only one letter from thick, no relation in meaning
entries.definitionCN: 诡计；与 thick 仅一字母之差，词义无关

entries.definition: packed closely together; formal partner of the crowded sense of thick
entries.definitionCN: 稠密的；thick 密集义的正式对应词

entries.definition: of great weight or force; overlaps with thick smoke and thick weather
entries.definitionCN: 沉重的；在浓烟、恶劣天气等用法上与 thick 交叠

entries.definition: not quick to understand; politer than the informal sense of thick
entries.definitionCN: 迟缓的；比 thick 的迟钝义更委婉

normalIntro.en: Real hooks: the Germanic root of pressed-together, the thick family, and two famous idioms.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：日耳曼「挤压密集」词根、thick 词族、以及两大著名习语。

normal.en: One image covers all senses: so much stuff that nothing moves easily.
normal.cn: 一个意象贯穿各义：东西多到什么都动弹不得。

normal.en: Thick fog, thick soup, thick forest: all hard to see through or push through.
normal.cn: 浓雾、浓汤、密林：都难以看穿或穿过。

normal.en: Through thick and thin once meant through forest and open ground.
normal.cn: through thick and thin 原指穿过密林与空地。

normal.en: Thick as thieves: as close and crowded together as partners in crime.
normal.cn: thick as thieves：像同伙一样亲密无间。

normal.en: Thicken the soup: the -en suffix turns the adjective into a verb.
normal.cn: thicken the soup：后缀 -en 把形容词变成动词。

abstract.en: Thick is the world pressing in from two sides at once.
abstract.cn: thick 是世界从两面同时挤进来的感觉。

abstract.en: A thick mind is a wall; a thick book is a door.
abstract.cn: 迟钝的头脑是墙，厚厚的书是门。

abstract.en: Where thin divides, thick protects.
abstract.cn: thin 分隔，thick 庇护。

examples.en: The walls are nearly a metre thick.
examples.cn: 这墙几乎有一米厚。

examples.en: A thick fog covered the harbour all morning.
examples.cn: 浓雾整个上午笼罩着海港。

examples.en: Her accent was thick with the sounds of her hometown.
examples.cn: 她的口音带着浓重的乡音。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「希克」——厚得只透一丝缝隙 → thick 厚的；浓的

root: 日耳曼本土词：原始日耳曼语词根（一般认为重构为 Theku，意为挤压密集）→ 古英语 Thicce「厚的、密的、浓的」，与德语 dick、荷兰语 dik 同源；无拉丁语来源。

sensesIntro.en: Thick measures size across a slab, then spreads to crowding, to dense liquids and smoke, and finally, with a smile, to a slow head.
sensesIntro.cn: thick 先量板子的厚度，再延伸到拥挤、浓稠的液体与烟雾，最后带笑指向迟钝的脑袋。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two faces pressed far apart, so full that nothing slips through.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个面被撑得很开，塞得满满，什么也穿不过。

branches.en: The physical measure of a slab or a wall.
branches.cn: 板与墙的物理厚度。

branches.en: Crowding that fills space like solid matter.
branches.cn: 像固体一样填满空间的拥挤。

branches.en: Liquids too dense to run freely.
branches.cn: 浓稠难流的液体。

branches.en: Fog that blocks the eye, a head that blocks the idea.
branches.cn: 挡住视线的雾，挡住想法的头脑。

branches.en: Both rest on one resistance: the world refusing to yield.
branches.cn: 两者立于同一种抗拒：世界拒绝让步。

intro.en: Thick is a bare Germanic root; English keeps it productive with small native suffixes like -en, -ness and -ly.
intro.cn: thick 是光秃秃的日耳曼词根；英语用 -en、-ness、-ly 等本土小后缀让它保持能产。

latinIntro.en: No Latin source exists; the family below is native or Norse, so the Latin entry list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁语来源；下表词族为本土或北欧来源，拉丁词条留空。

items.example: Stir in flour to thicken the stew.

items.meaning: the quality or measure of being thick
items.example: The ice reached a thickness of half a metre.
Snow fell thickly all night.
A rabbit vanished into the thicket.
items.exampleCN: 兔子钻进灌木丛不见了。

items.example: A thickset guard stood at the gate.
items.exampleCN: 一名矮壮的卫兵站在门口。

items.example: You need to be thick-skinned in politics.

items.meaningCN: 德语「厚的」，与 thick 同根
items.example: German dick means thick, not the English noun.
items.exampleCN: 德语 dick 意为厚，与英语名词无关。

items.meaning: through good and bad times alike
items.meaningCN: 同甘共苦；无论顺境逆境
items.example: They stayed friends through thick and thin.
items.exampleCN: 他们同甘共苦，友谊未变。

definition_zh: 厚厚地；浓密地；含混不清地
definition_en: in a thick way: covering densely, speaking unclearly, or growing closely together
core_image: 雪一层压一层落下，声音都被压软了
scene: 整夜的雪把松枝压弯了腰。Snow fell thickly on the pine branches.
sceneCN: 这里 thickly 是「厚厚地、层层地」（第 1 个义项：以厚的状态覆盖）；句意：雪厚厚地落在松枝上。

derivatives.zh: 厚的；浓的；密的（thickly 的形容词基础）
厚度；浓度（thick 加名词后缀 -ness）
使变厚；变浓（thick 加动词后缀 -en）
薄薄地；稀疏地（thin 加 -ly，与 thickly 意义相对）

senses.title: Covering densely in a layer
senses.definition: in a deep or dense layer, so that the surface beneath is hidden
senses.definitionCN: 以厚实浓密的一层覆盖，把底下之物遮住
senses.example: Paint lay thickly on the old door.
senses.exampleCN: 旧门上的漆积得厚厚的。
senses.why: The adverb simply performs the adjective: what thick measures, thickly does.
senses.whyCN: 副词只是把形容词付诸行动：thick 所量出的，thickly 去做出来。

senses.title: In an unclear or muffled voice
senses.definition: (of speech) in a way that is hard to understand, as from a dry throat, drink, or emotion
senses.definitionCN: 指说话含混难懂，如因喉咙干、饮酒或激动
senses.example: He apologized thickly, his words slurred.
senses.exampleCN: 他口齿含混地道了歉，话都说不清。
senses.why: A blocked mouth is like a blocked street: the crowd in the way thickens the sound until the meaning cannot pass.
senses.whyCN: 堵塞的嘴如同堵塞的街道：中间挤着的东西把声音压得发闷，意思过不去了。

senses.title: Closely packed or frequent
senses.definition: closely together, as of growth, population, or repeated events
senses.definitionCN: 紧密相连，指生长、人口或事件的密集
senses.example: Houses stand thickly along the river bank.
senses.exampleCN: 房屋密密地沿河岸排开。
senses.why: Crowding in space or in time gets the same name: thickness of things instead of thickness of matter.
senses.whyCN: 空间上或时间上的密集共用同一个名字：是事物的厚度，而非物质的厚度。

intro.en: Thickly is thick plus the native adverb ending -ly. Its history is the history of the adjective it comes from, plus the slow growth of the -ly adverb system in English.
intro.cn: thickly 由 thick 加本土副词后缀 -ly 构成。它的历史就是它所源出的形容词的历史，再加上英语 -ly 副词体系的缓慢成形。

items.en: The root goes back to the common Germanic word for thick and pressed close, shared across the Germanic languages.
items.cn: 词根追溯到日耳曼语族共有的「厚、挤压紧密」一词，各日耳曼语言同源。

items.en: Old English used Thicce itself as an adverb, without any ending: the snow fell thicce.
items.cn: 古英语直接用 Thicce 兼作副词，不加后缀：雪 thicce 地落下。

items.en: Middle English allowed both thick and thikke(or thick)-ly; the -ly form was at first formal and bookish.
items.cn: 中古英语中 thick 与 thikke(or thick)ly 并用；-ly 形式起初偏正式书面。

items.en: By the seventeenth century thickly had won the adverbial job in careful writing, while bare thick stayed in poetry and speech.
items.cn: 到十七世纪，thickly 在严谨书面语中接掌了副词职务，光杆 thick 留在诗歌与口语里。

items.en: Modern English uses thickly for layers, crowds and muffled voices, and keeps the picture of the adjective alive in every use.
items.cn: 现代英语用 thickly 表示层层覆盖、人群密集与含混声音，每一处用法都保留着形容词的画面。

note.en: The first group is the thick family in different parts of speech; the second holds adverbs of density and clarity.
note.cn: 第一组是 thick 词族的不同词性形式；第二组是表示密度与清晰度的副词。

entries.definition: the adjective from which thickly is built; also used alone as an adverb in speech
entries.definitionCN: thickly 的形容词基础；口语中也可直接作副词

entries.definition: a dense mass of bushes; thick with the noun ending -et
entries.definitionCN: 灌木丛；thick 加名词后缀 -et

entries.definition: often ill or pale; built the same way from sick but unrelated in meaning
entries.definitionCN: 多病的；由 sick 同样加 -ly 构成，但词义与 thickly 无关

entries.definition: in a closely packed way; the formal partner of the crowded sense
entries.definitionCN: 密集地；thickly 密集义的正式对应词

entries.definition: in large amounts or with force; overlaps with falling snow or rain
entries.definitionCN: 大量地；沉重地；与 snow/rain heavily 用法交叠

entries.definition: in a thin or sparse way; the direct opposite
entries.definitionCN: 薄薄地；稀疏地；thickly 的直接反义词

normalIntro.en: Real hooks: thick plus -ly, the bare adverb use in speech, and the opposite thinly.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：thick 加 -ly、口语中光杆 thick 作副词、以及反义词 thinly。

normal.en: Thickly = thick + ly: the adjective put to work.
normal.cn: thickly 就是 thick 加 ly：让形容词去干活。

normal.en: Snow falls thickly, but people say it falls thick in daily talk.
normal.cn: 书面说雪 thickly 落下，日常口语只说 thick。

normal.en: He spoke thickly: his tongue moved as if through fog.
normal.cn: 他说话含混：舌头像在雾里打转。

normal.en: A thickly wooded hill is a hill wearing a thick green coat.
normal.cn: 林木 thickly 的小山，是穿着厚绿外套的山。

normal.en: Compare thinly sliced bread with thickly spread butter.
normal.cn: 对比切得 thin 的面包与抹得 thick 的黄油。

abstract.en: Thickly is the adjective put into motion.
abstract.cn: thickly 是走上行动的形容词。

abstract.en: A voice thickly spoken is a voice wearing a scarf.
abstract.cn: 含混的嗓音，是围了围巾的声音。

abstract.en: The world can be dressed thickly or thinly; most of us choose in between.
abstract.cn: 世界可以厚着穿也可以薄着穿，多数人取乎其中。

examples.en: Flour dusted thickly over the baking table.
examples.cn: 面粉厚厚地撒在烘焙台上。

examples.en: The region is thickly covered with tea gardens.
examples.cn: 这一地区密密地遍布茶园。

examples.en: She smiled thickly through her tears.
examples.cn: 她含着泪，哽咽地笑了笑。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「希克利」——厚得让人希奇,一层又一层 → thickly 厚厚地

root: 本土构词：日耳曼词根 thick「厚、密」+ 古英语副词后缀 -ly（-lice）；古英语以光杆形容词作副词，-ly 形式后起并渐成书面标准。

sensesIntro.en: Thickly lays things down in layers, muffles a voice, and crowds things together, always moving the adjective thick into the world of action.
sensesIntro.cn: thickly 或层层铺覆，或压闷声音，或使事物密集，始终把形容词 thick 带进动作的世界。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the adjective thick doing something, layer after layer.
core.cn: 核心意象：形容词 thick 动了起来，一层又一层。

branches.en: Layers that hide what lies beneath.
branches.cn: 遮住底物的层层覆盖。

branches.en: Sound thickened until meaning cannot pass.
branches.cn: 被压闷到意思过不去的声音。

branches.en: Crowding in space, houses and trees shoulder to shoulder.
branches.cn: 空间上的密集，房屋与树木比肩而立。

branches.en: Both are the adjective thick performed on a scene.
branches.cn: 两者都是形容词 thick 在场景中的演出。

branches.en: The voice borrows the fog of the weather.
branches.cn: 嗓音借用了天气的浓雾。

intro.en: Thickly shows the most common English adverb builder, -ly, added straight to a native root.
intro.cn: thickly 展示了英语最常见的副词构造成分 -ly，直接加在本土词根上。

latinIntro.en: No Latin source; the -ly system is native English, so the Latin entry list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁语来源；-ly 体系为英语本土，拉丁词条留空。

items.example: Slowly, quickly, thickly all follow the same rule.
Vines grew thickly over the wall.
The soup was thinly spread on the plate.
The city is densely populated.

items.meaning: in large amount or with weight
items.example: It rained heavily all night.
A thickset man guarded the door.
items.exampleCN: 一名壮实的汉子守着门。

items.example: She finished quickly.

items.meaning: in large numbers, one after another
items.example: Questions came thick and fast.

definition_zh: 厚；厚度；浓度； thick 一层
definition_en: the measure of how thick something is, or a layer of something
core_image: 卡尺咬住一块板：两面之间的距离变成了一个数字
scene: 湖心的冰层可以行车了，人们用卡尺量了又量。The ice reached a safe thickness before the cars crossed.
sceneCN: 这里 thickness 是「厚度」（第 1 个义项：两面之间的量度）；句意：冰的厚度达到安全标准后车辆才通过。

derivatives.zh: 厚的；浓的（thickness 的形容词基础）
使变厚；变浓（thick 加动词后缀 -en）
厚厚地；浓密地（thick 加副词后缀 -ly）
黑暗（同用 -ness 后缀的平行词）

senses.title: The measure between two surfaces
senses.definition: the distance between two opposite surfaces of something solid
senses.definitionCN: 固体两个相对表面之间的距离
senses.example: The thickness of the door blocks most street noise.
senses.exampleCN: 这扇门的厚度挡住了街上大部分噪音。
senses.why: The adjective thick measures; adding -ness turns the measurement itself into a thing you can name and count.
senses.whyCN: 形容词 thick 负责测量；加上 -ness 后，测量结果本身变成可以命名与计数的名词。

senses.title: Density of a liquid or substance
senses.definition: the degree to which a liquid or soft substance does not flow easily
senses.definitionCN: 液体或软性物质不易流动的程度
senses.example: Cook the jam until it reaches the right thickness.
senses.exampleCN: 把果酱熬到合适的稠度。
senses.why: The same measure works inside matter: how much substance is crowded into the space decides the flow.
senses.whyCN: 同一种度量也作用于物质内部：挤进同一空间的物质多少决定了流动性。

senses.title: A layer of something spread
senses.definition: a layer of a substance lying on a surface, or a dense mass in the air
senses.definitionCN: 铺在表面上的物质层，或空气中浓密的一团
senses.example: A thickness of dust covered every shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 每层架子上都积了厚厚一层灰。
senses.why: Once you can measure thickness, the thing measured can also be lifted out and treated as an object in itself.
senses.whyCN: 厚度既然可以度量，被度量的那层东西也就能被单独拎出来当作一个对象。

senses.title: The middle of a solid mass
senses.definition: the middle or densest part of something, as in the thickness of a forest
senses.definitionCN: 某物最厚实或最密的部分，如密林深处
senses.example: They lost their way in the thickness of the wood.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在密林深处迷了路。
senses.why: The densest interior feels like the deep of the mass, where layers press from every side at once.
senses.whyCN: 最密的内部让人觉得像实体深处，各方的层叠同时挤压过来。

intro.en: Thickness is thick plus the old English noun ending -ness, one of the most durable suffixes in the language, turning any adjective into the name of its quality.
intro.cn: thickness 由 thick 加古英语名词后缀 -ness 构成；-ness 是英语最耐久的后缀之一，能把任何形容词变成其性质的名称。

items.en: The adjective root is the common Germanic word for thick and pressed close.
items.cn: 形容词词根是日耳曼语族共有的「厚、挤压紧密」一词。

items.en: Old English formed Thicnes(or thickness) with the suffix -nes, already meaning the quality of being thick.
items.cn: 古英语用后缀 -nes 构成 Thicnes(or thickness)，已表示「厚的性质」。

items.en: Middle English thiknesse served for layers, crowds and fluids alike, spreading with the crafts that measured cloth, metal and glass.
items.cn: 中古英语 thiknesse 兼指层、群与流体，随量布、量金属、量玻璃的手工业而推广。

items.en: Engineering made the word technical: wall thickness, plate thickness, coating thickness all became precise industrial terms.
items.cn: 工程学使该词技术化：壁厚、板厚、涂层厚度都成为精确的工业术语。

items.en: The figurative uses, the thickness of the crowd or of the silence, keep the physical image alive.
items.cn: 人群之密、沉默之浓等比喻用法让物理意象保持鲜活。

note.en: The first group holds the -ness family built on thick; the second gathers nouns of measure and depth.
note.cn: 第一组是基于 thick 的 -ness 词族；第二组是表量度与深度的名词。

entries.definition: the adjective that thickness names the quality of
entries.definitionCN: thick：thickness 所命名之性质的形容词

entries.definition: the verb of making thicker
entries.definitionCN: 使变厚的动词

entries.definition: the state of being ill; shares the -ness ending but not the root
entries.definitionCN: 疾病；同用 -ness 后缀但词根不同

entries.definition: the distance from top to bottom or front to back
entries.definitionCN: 深度；从前到后或从上到下的距离

entries.definition: the distance from side to side
entries.definitionCN: 宽度；从一侧到另一侧的距离

entries.definition: the degree of crowding of matter in a space
entries.definitionCN: 密度；物质在空间中的密集程度

normalIntro.en: Real hooks: thick plus -ness, the measure words of the same shape, and the layer sense.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：thick 加 -ness、同形量度词、以及「一层」的义项。

normal.en: Thickness = how thick: the adjective becomes a number.
normal.cn: thickness 就是「有多厚」：形容词变成了数字。

normal.en: Depth, width, length, thickness: the four measures of any solid.
normal.cn: 深、宽、长、厚：任何固体的四项量度。

normal.en: Jam is judged by its thickness, soup by its thinness.
normal.cn: 果酱看稠度，汤看稀薄度。

normal.en: A thickness of dust: the measure becomes a layer you can wipe away.
normal.cn: a thickness of dust：量度变成能擦掉的一层灰。

normal.en: The thickness of the forest is where paths give up.
normal.cn: 密林深处是小路认输的地方。

abstract.en: Thickness is the answer to the question every solid is asked.
abstract.cn: thickness 是每个固体都被问到的问题的答案。

abstract.en: A number that began as a feeling of pressure between two palms.
abstract.cn: 一个数字，最初是两只手掌之间的挤压感。

abstract.en: Every crowd has a thickness you could almost weigh.
abstract.cn: 每群人都有几乎可以称量的厚度。

examples.en: The thickness of the ice was checked twice.
examples.cn: 冰的厚度被检查了两遍。

examples.en: Adjust the thickness of the line in the settings.
examples.cn: 在设置里调整线条的粗细。

examples.en: A thickness of fog hid the whole valley.
examples.cn: 一团浓雾遮住了整个山谷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「希克纳斯」——厚到希奇的纳斯卡地画，量量多厚 → thickness 厚度

root: thick「厚的」（日耳曼本土词根）+ -ness「性质」（古英语 -nes）→ 「厚的性质」即厚度；与 depth、width 同属本土量度名词系统。

sensesIntro.en: Thickness first names a measurement, then the density that causes it, the layer you can see, and the deep middle of a solid mass.
sensesIntro.cn: thickness 先指一个测量值，再指造成它的浓度、看得见的那一层，以及实体的深处。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the gap between two faces, caught and turned into a number.
core.cn: 核心意象：两面之间的空隙被卡住，变成一个数字。

branches.en: The plain measurement of solid things.
branches.cn: 固体的朴素测量。

branches.en: How much substance crowds a liquid.
branches.cn: 液体里挤了多少物质。

branches.en: The layer you can point at and wipe away.
branches.cn: 可以指着并擦掉的那一层。

branches.en: The deepest part, where the mass is thickest.
branches.cn: 实体最厚实的深处。

branches.en: Both are the same number seen from outside and inside.
branches.cn: 两者是同一数字的内外两副面孔。

intro.en: Thickness is a textbook case of the suffix -ness: adjective in, quality noun out.
intro.cn: thickness 是后缀 -ness 的教科书案例：形容词进，性质名词出。

latinIntro.en: No Latin source; -ness is a native English suffix, so the Latin entry list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁语来源；-ness 为本土后缀，拉丁词条留空。

items.example: Kindness, darkness, thickness all end in -ness.
Check the thickness of the glass.

items.meaningCN: 深度（用旧后缀 -th 的平行词）
items.example: The depth of the well surprised them.
The width of the river doubles in spring.
The length of the bridge is two kilometres.
The warmth of the room eased him.
items.exampleCN: 房间的暖意让他放松下来。

items.example: Darkness fell over the valley.
His one weakness is chocolate.
items.exampleCN: 他唯一的弱点是巧克力。

definition_zh: 贼；小偷；偷窃者
definition_en: a person who steals things from another person or place, especially secretly and without violence
core_image: 黑影伸手进别人的口袋：拿走不属于自己的东西
scene: 集市散场时,他的钱包不见了。A thief slipped the wallet out of his pocket in the crowd.
sceneCN: 这里 thief 是「小偷」（第 1 个义项：以隐蔽手段偷窃的人）；句意：人群中小偷把钱包从他口袋里摸走了。

collocations.phrase: set a thief to catch a thief
collocations.zh: 以贼擒贼；以其人之道还治其身

collocations.phrase: like a thief in the night

derivatives.zh: 偷窃；盗窃（行为）（同根名词，指偷窃这一行为而非人）
偷窃（罕见动词形式，由名词逆构）
偷；窃取（ thief 的行为动词，非同根）
扒手（ thief 的具体类型，指在人群中行窃者）

senses.title: A person who steals secretly
senses.definition: a person who takes things that belong to others, secretly and without using force
senses.definitionCN: 暗中取走他人财物、不使用暴力的人
senses.example: A thief broke into the car and took the radio.
senses.exampleCN: 小偷撬开汽车拿走了收音机。
senses.why: The word names the person by the act: to thieve is to take, and the thief is the taker.
senses.whyCN: 这个词以行为命名其人：thieve 是拿走，thief 就是拿走的人。

senses.title: One who takes dishonestly in general
senses.titleCN: 偷窃者；窃取他人成果的人
senses.definition: a person who takes credit, ideas, or time that is not rightfully theirs
senses.definitionCN: 窃取本不属于自己的荣誉、点子或时间的人
senses.example: He called his rival a thief of other people's ideas.
senses.exampleCN: 他称对手为窃取他人点子的贼。
senses.why: Anything that can be owned can be stolen, so the word walks out of the marketplace into business, art and argument.
senses.whyCN: 凡可拥有的皆可被窃，于是这个词走出集市，进入商业、艺术与论战。

senses.title: Time or thief of time idiom
senses.titleCN: 偷走时间等无形之物者
senses.definition: something that takes away time, sleep, or opportunity invisibly
senses.definitionCN: 无声无息夺走时间、睡眠或机会的事物
senses.example: The midnight scroll is a thief of sleep.
senses.exampleCN: 深夜刷屏是偷走睡眠的贼。
senses.why: The invisible theft is still theft: what quietly removes something of yours earns the old name.
senses.whyCN: 看不见的偷窃仍是偷窃：悄悄拿走你之物者，配得上这个古老的名称。

intro.en: Thief is a native Germanic word, and its f to v plural change (thief, thieves) is a fossil of an old sound rule that still lives in English grammar.
intro.cn: thief 是日耳曼本土词；其复数 f 变 v（thief→thieves）是一条古老音变规则留在英语语法中的化石。

items.en: The common Germanic root Theub, generally reconstructed, meant to steal; it has no relatives in Latin.
items.cn: 公认的日耳曼词根一般重构为 Theub，意为「偷」；它在拉丁语中没有同源词。

items.en: Old English Theof (or Theof) meant thief, with the plural Theofas already showing the v-sound between vowels.
items.cn: 古英语 Theof 意为「贼」，复数 Theofas 已在元音之间显出 v 音。

items.en: Norse Tjof(or tjof)r, a cousin form, supported the northern usage and spelling.
items.cn: 古诺斯语的同源形式支持了北方的用法与拼写。

items.en: Middle English Theef (or thef) developed the modern plural thieves, fixing the f to v alternation.
items.cn: 中古英语确立现代复数 thieves，固定了 f 与 v 的交替。

items.en: Modern English separated thief (the person) from theft (the act), and the plural thieves became the model taught in schools.
items.cn: 现代英语把 thief（人）与 theft（行为）分开，复数 thieves 成为课堂范本。

note.en: The first group holds the thief-theft family; the second gathers words for takers of different kinds.
note.cn: 第一组是 thief-theft 词族；第二组是各类「拿走者」的词。

entries.definition: the act of stealing; the thief commits a theft
entries.definitionCN: 盗窃行为；thief 所犯下的即是 theft

entries.definition: to steal; a rare verb built back from the noun
entries.definitionCN: 偷窃；由名词逆构的罕见动词

entries.definition: a leader; one letter from thief in spelling, unrelated in origin
entries.definitionCN: 首领；拼写与 thief 仅一字母之差，词源无关

entries.definition: one who breaks into buildings to steal, usually at night
entries.definitionCN: 夜盗；破门入室行窃者，多在夜间

entries.definition: one who takes property by force or threat, as in a bank robbery
entries.definitionCN: 抢劫者；以武力或威胁取财，如银行劫匪

entries.definition: a thief who steals from pockets in crowds
entries.definitionCN: 扒手；在人群中从口袋行窃的贼

normalIntro.en: Real hooks: the Germanic root, the f-v plural, and the thief-theft pair.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：日耳曼词根、f 变 v 的复数、以及 thief-theft 对。

normal.en: Thief ends in f; the plural steals a v: thief, thieves.
normal.cn: thief 以 f 结尾；复数偷来一个 v：thief, thieves。

normal.en: A thief takes people; theft takes things as its object of talk.
normal.cn: thief 指人；theft 指偷窃行为。

normal.en: Burglar breaks in, robber threatens, thief only slips away.
normal.cn: burglar 破门，robber 动武，thief 只是悄然溜走。

normal.en: Set a thief to catch a thief: only a thief knows the thief's roads.
normal.cn: 以贼擒贼：只有贼才认得贼的路。

normal.en: A thief in the night is quiet, which is the whole point.
normal.cn: 夜贼的要义就是安静无声。

abstract.en: A thief is defined by a hand that is not his own.
abstract.cn: 小偷的定义，是一只不属于他的手。

abstract.en: The quietest theft is the one you notice only by the empty space left behind.
abstract.cn: 最安静的偷窃，是你只凭留下的空位才察觉的那次。

abstract.en: Time is the thief that never gets caught.
abstract.cn: 时间是从不被抓获的贼。

examples.en: The thief was caught on camera.
examples.cn: 小偷被摄像头拍了下来。

examples.en: Thieves stole copper cables from the site.
examples.cn: 窃贼从工地偷走了铜缆。

examples.en: Opportunity knocked once, and worry proved a thief of it.
examples.cn: 机会只敲一次门，而忧虑把它偷走了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「西夫」——夜里偷东西的人最怕「西夫」（警察吹哨声） → thief 小偷

root: 日耳曼本土词：词根一般重构为 Theub「偷」→ 古英语 Theof「贼」；复数经古英语元音间浊化变为 thieves；名词 theft「盗窃行为」同根。

sensesIntro.en: Thief names the secret taker first, then anyone who takes what is not theirs, and finally the quiet stealers of time and sleep.
sensesIntro.cn: thief 先指暗中窃取者，再泛指拿走不属于自己的东西的人，最后指向时间与睡眠的无声窃贼。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand reaching quietly for what belongs to another.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手悄悄伸向属于别人的东西。

branches.en: The plain wrongdoer of property.
branches.cn: 侵害财产的朴素作恶者。

branches.en: The taker of credit and ideas.
branches.cn: 窃取荣誉与点子的人。

branches.en: The invisible thief of time and sleep.
branches.cn: 时间与睡眠的无形窃贼。

branches.en: Both senses need an owner to wrong; theft is always a triangle.
branches.cn: 两义都需要被侵害的所有者；偷窃永远是三角形。

branches.en: The metaphor keeps the silence of the original image.
branches.cn: 比喻保留了原初意象的寂静。

intro.en: Thief has almost no derivational family; the f-v plural and the act noun theft carry the whole grammar of the word.
intro.cn: thief 几乎没有派生词族；f-v 复数与行为名词 theft 承载了它的全部语法。

latinIntro.en: No Latin source; the family is purely Germanic, so the Latin entry list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁语来源；词族纯出日耳曼，拉丁词条留空。
